# LX-N Music Aurora 1.8.85-aurora.2

[简体中文](#简体中文) | [English](#english)

## 简体中文

这是基于 <code>souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile</code> 的非官方 Aurora 维护版。

### 本次内容

- 播放与下载支持“同源优先”和“同音质优先”两种链接回退策略。
- 播放详情可显示并切换当前歌曲的实际可用音质。
- 包含外部音源的音质映射、URL 解析、下载空文件保护和歌词体验改进。
- 保留 LX-N Music 的原有主要功能和 Android 包名。

### 安装

本 Release 使用新的私有签名。若已安装旧 Aurora、原版 LX-N Music 或其它相同包名但不同
签名的版本，请先导出重要数据、卸载旧版，再安装本 Release。后续 Aurora 版本可直接覆盖升级。

## English

This is an unofficial Aurora maintenance release based on
<code>souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile</code>.

### Included

- Playback and downloads support both source-first and quality-first URL
  fallback strategies.
- The play detail screen displays and selects the actual available quality for
  the current track.
- Includes external-source quality mapping, URL resolution, empty-download
  protection, and lyric experience improvements.
- Keeps the main LX-N Music feature set and Android package id.

### Installation

This Release uses a new private signing key. If an older Aurora build, stock
LX-N Music build, or another same-package build with a different signature is
installed, export important data and uninstall it before installing this
Release. Future Aurora releases will update in place.
